terms.metadataDescription: Learn the rules for using {site} accounts, AI creation, user content, credits, payments, refunds, public publishing, and account deletion.
terms.intro: These terms explain the rights and responsibilities for accounts, creative content, AI results, credit payments, refunds, and public publishing when using {site}.

0.title: You are responsible for inputs and publishing
0.body: Make sure you have permission to use uploaded text, images, audio, video, likenesses, brands, and other materials, and review AI results before publishing.

1.title: Credits and generation status are traceable
1.body: Prices and estimated credits appear before submission or in task details; eligible failed or cancelled tasks record returned credits.

2.title: Illegal and infringing use is prohibited
2.body: Do not use the service for fraud, impersonation, harassment, privacy violations, illegal content, system attacks, or bypassing safeguards.

paragraphs.0: These Terms apply to your use of the {site} website, Creative Agent, image and video generation, Canvas, short dramas, assets, publishing, and credit top-ups.
paragraphs.1: By registering, signing in, or continuing to use the service, you confirm that you have read and accepted these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you act for an organization, you confirm that you are authorized to accept them on its behalf.

paragraphs.0: Provide accurate, usable registration information, protect your password and devices, and take responsibility for account activity. If you discover unauthorized access, change your password and contact the operator through Help immediately.
paragraphs.1: You may not resell accounts, register in bulk, impersonate others, or bypass permission, concurrency, credit, or risk controls. We may limit unusual requests, pause high-risk operations, or require verification to protect users and the service.

paragraphs.0: You retain rights in content you lawfully upload. To fulfill your requests, you grant the service permission to store, copy, transcode, transmit, and process that content as necessary; this does not transfer ownership to us.
paragraphs.1: You must have the necessary copyright, trademark, likeness, voice, privacy, and other permissions for your materials and prompts. Do not request content likely to mislead, defraud, or harm another person's rights.
paragraphs.2: You may use generated results where law and upstream model terms allow. AI output may resemble other content and is not guaranteed to be exclusive, copyrightable, or suitable for a specific commercial purpose. Review it before publishing and accept responsibility for its use.

paragraphs.0: Agent responses and generated results come from automated models and may contain factual errors, omissions, bias, visual defects, or unusable output. The service is not legal, medical, investment, or other professional advice.
paragraphs.1: Models, speed, parameters, and result counts vary with configuration, provider capabilities, networks, and safety requirements. Running tasks may take time; follow the page status and do not submit the same task repeatedly.

paragraphs.0: The top-up amount, server-quoted credits, promotion, exchange-rate version, and payment method are defined by the top-up page and order snapshot. Review the order before paying; payment is complete only after the channel confirms it and the system verifies the order status.
paragraphs.1: Generation tasks deduct credits according to the displayed model, parameters, quantity, and rules. Eligible credits are automatically returned when the system classifies a task as failed or cancelled. Successfully delivered or consumed work, and costs caused by illegal submissions, are not automatically refundable.
paragraphs.2: For an order refund, submit the order number and reason through the operator's published support channel. Eligibility, scope, arrival time through the original payment channel, and reversal of credited funds depend on the top-up terms, applicable law, and final decision. Do not pay or apply for the same order twice.

paragraphs.0: Do not upload, generate, or distribute criminal, infringing, hateful, harassing, sexually exploitative, inappropriate minor-related, maliciously false, privacy-violating, fraudulent, impersonating, malware, or safeguard-evasion content.
paragraphs.1: Public works may undergo automated or human review, reports, removal, and appeals. To protect users and the platform, we may reject tasks, remove public content, restrict features, or suspend accounts; serious legal risks may be preserved and reported as required by law.

paragraphs.0: We work to keep the service stable, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted access, permanent model availability, or that every result meets subjective expectations. Maintenance, provider failures, networks, force majeure, and legal requirements may cause delays, interruptions, or changes.
paragraphs.1: To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for indirect loss, lost expected profit, or loss caused by failure to back up important work, verify AI output, or obtain rights to materials. Liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited remains unaffected.

7.title: Deletion, account closure, updates, and disputes

paragraphs.0: You can delete creative records or request account deletion. Deletion follows media-reference protection, transaction-record, and legal-retention requirements; see the Privacy Policy for details.
paragraphs.1: We may update these Terms when features, providers, prices, or laws change. Important changes will be announced in the service, at sign-in, or through renewed consent; review the updated version before continuing.
paragraphs.2: For disputes about orders, content decisions, privacy, or these Terms, first contact the operator through Help and published support channels. Applicable law, jurisdiction, and non-waivable consumer rights depend on the operator's location, your location, and relevant law.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metadataDescription: Learn how {site} handles accounts, creative content, AI requests, transactions, and media data, and which choices and rights are available to you.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {site} handles information when you register, create, purchase, and manage your account, and how you can control your data.

0.title: You control your creative content
0.body: Your conversations, projects, prompts, and media are used to provide features you request and are not shown publicly unless you publish or share them.

1.title: AI requests pass through third parties
1.body: When you generate text, images, video, or audio, required prompts, parameters, and selected reference materials are sent to the model provider that performs the task.

2.title: Access, export, and account deletion
2.body: In Profile you can manage details, review orders and credit records, export account data, and submit or withdraw an account-deletion request.

paragraphs.0: Account data includes username, display name, email, avatar, encrypted password credentials, sign-in and security records, and the versions and times when you accepted this policy and the Terms.
paragraphs.1: Creative and project data includes text, prompts, attachments, creative conversations, Canvas, short dramas, assets, generation parameters, task status, and generated results.
paragraphs.2: Top-up and transaction data includes orders, payment-channel transaction status, quote snapshots, credit balances and activity, and refunds. We do not store or display complete bank-card information on the page.
paragraphs.3: Device and operational data includes IP address, browser information, request times, errors, and necessary audit records used for sign-in security, rate limiting, and troubleshooting.

paragraphs.0: We use it to create and protect accounts, restore conversations and projects, run generation tasks, display and download results, settle payments and credits, and respond to support, security, and deletion requests you initiate.
paragraphs.1: We also use it to prevent abuse, fraud, unauthorized access, and duplicate charges, diagnose service failures, and comply with law. We process only what is needed for the relevant feature.

paragraphs.0: Creative Agent first understands your current request, then chooses available models and parameters. Internal planning prompts, model-selection steps, and execution rules are not shown as your public content.
paragraphs.1: Model services may process prompts, references, and task parameters and generate text or media. Provider retention and training policies may differ. Avoid unnecessary sensitive data such as identity documents, financial or medical information, and unpublished trade secrets.
paragraphs.2: AI results may be inaccurate, incomplete, or inconsistent with reality. Before publishing, commercial use, or important decisions, verify facts, copyright, likeness rights, and compliance risks.

3.title: When we provide information to third parties

paragraphs.0: We provide necessary information to model, payment, email, object-storage, or content-delivery services only when required for a specific feature. They receive only the data needed for that task.
paragraphs.1: We may disclose necessary information when lawfully required by legislation, courts, or regulators, or to protect users, the platform, and others. We do not sell personal information.

paragraphs.0: Accounts, projects, conversations, and long-term assets are generally retained until you delete them or close the account. Pre-send attachments stay only in page memory and become account assets after sending. Orders, payments, refunds, and security audits are retained as required by law and disputes.
paragraphs.1: We use access controls, encrypted credentials, media ownership checks, short-lived signed URLs, operational audits, and backups. No network service can promise absolute security; protect your password and report unusual activity promptly.

paragraphs.0: In Profile you can update details and passwords, view orders, credits, and usage, download media you may access, and export account data.
paragraphs.1: You can delete creative conversations, Canvas projects, short dramas, assets, or publications. The system first checks whether other projects reference the same media; legitimately referenced files remain until those references are removed, preventing silent breakage.
paragraphs.2: You can request account deletion in Profile and withdraw it before processing. Deletable account and creative data will be removed or de-identified; legally required transaction, security, and dispute records are isolated for the required period.

paragraphs.0: If you are below the age of independent consent for online services where you live, use the service only after a guardian has read and accepted this policy. Do not upload sensitive or inappropriate content about minors.
paragraphs.1: We may update this policy when features, providers, or laws change. Important changes will be announced in the service, at sign-in, or through renewed consent, and we retain the policy version accepted at registration.
paragraphs.2: For access, correction, deletion, account closure, or complaints, first use Profile and Help. When manual handling is needed, contact the operator through its published support channel.
